sources.title_original: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
sources.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
You can now link your Hugging Face organization to your Google Cloud account, so that your Hugging Face usage shows up on your Google Cloud bill instead of being charged to a credit card. Get started on the Google Cloud Marketplace .
Hugging Face is where teams find, build and run op
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇文章讲 Hugging Face 组织如何通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 关联 Google Cloud 账户，把 Hugging Face 用量计入云账单而非信用卡，并说明订阅需团队审核、已绑卡组织下个账单周期切换。

en.reason: Linking a Hugging Face organization to a Google Cloud account through Google Cloud Marketplace now bills Hugging Face usage on the Google Cloud invoice instead of a credit card, though subscription requires team review and already card-linked organizations switch at the next billing cycle.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Cloud发布Gemini for healthcare，整合电子健康记录、账单平台与Medicare数据集，针对临床人员每周近28小时的文书负担，并携手HCA Healthcare等合作方预览病历综合与事前授权审核流程。

en.reason: Google Cloud’s Gemini for healthcare unifies electronic health records, billing platforms and Medicare datasets while targeting clinicians’ nearly 28-hour weekly documentation burden, with HCA Healthcare among partners previewing record synthesis and prior authorization review workflows.

sources.title_zh: ChatGPT 推出 Businesses 功能
sources.title_original: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
sources.summary:
Title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/introducing-businesses-chatgpt/
We’re introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, giving businesses a new way to connect with the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT each week. Through [Business Hub⁠(opens in a new window)](https://chatgpt.com/business-hub?utm_source=openai&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=business_agents_launch&utm_content=smb_launch_primary_cta), businesses can claim their business, manage their information
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 推出 beta 版 Businesses in ChatGPT，让企业通过 Business Hub 认领信息并查看提及与网站点击洞察，美国符合条件的电商和在线服务企业还可启用 Business Agents，连接每周 12 亿用户。

en.reason: OpenAI's beta Businesses in ChatGPT lets companies claim and manage their information via Business Hub, see mention and website-click insights, and—for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses—enable Business Agents to reach ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users.

items.title: Dependabot 将暂停对不活跃仓库的提醒 / Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories

sources.title: Dependabot 将暂停对不活跃仓库的提醒 / Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories

sources.title_en: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories
sources.title_original: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 2026年12月8日起，GitHub 将暂停过去一年无活动仓库的 Dependabot alerts，现有告警归档不删除，任意 push 可自动恢复并重置一年计时。

en.reason: From December 8, 2026, GitHub will pause Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year, archiving rather than deleting existing alerts, with any push restoring them and resetting the one-year timer.

sources.summary:
Since the new dashboard experience became the default, we’ve heard from developers that it used too much space to show too little. Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default…
Since the new dashboard experience became the default, we’ve heard from developers that it used too much space to show too little. Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default item count meant extra navigation just to see what needed attention. In addition, “Agent sessions” remained visible even if users did
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 新 dashboard 因宽松内边距、换行标题和低默认条目数被开发者反馈“占空间多、信息少”，本次更新将其改得更紧凑易扫，并让无可用会话时的 Agent sessions 不再显示。

en.reason: GitHub's dashboard update makes the layout more compact and scannable after developers complained that generous padding, wrapped titles and a low default item count showed too little, and it no longer displays Agent sessions when none are available.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 11月10日，ByteDance 旗下 AI 应用 Doubao 正式接入 Seedream5.5 图像模型，支持对同一作品最多 100 轮连续编辑且不偏移未改区域，并可直接生成原生 RGBA 透明素材，省去抠图步骤。

en.title: ByteDance's Seedream 5.5 officially launches on Doubao, bringing a comprehensive upgrade to its image design capabilities
en.reason: ByteDance’s Doubao integrated the Seedream 5.5 image model on November 10, enabling up to 100 rounds of continuous edits that leave unmodified areas unchanged and native RGBA transparent assets without cutout work.

sources.title_original: 肯德基在日本翻车：AI 画的商品图，连冰块都"染了色"
sources.recommend_reason_zh: KFC Japan 11月10日被ITmedia曝出试销新品用生成式AI商品图，冰块被染成与汽水同色、带果冻光泽，网友识破后品牌承认用AI却拒答是否推广。

en.title: KFC's Japan blunder: AI-generated product images — even the ice cubes came out "dyed
en.reason: KFC Japan was reported by ITmedia on November 10 after its AI-generated product image for a trial new drink showed ice cubes tinted the same colour as the soda with a jelly-like sheen, and the brand confirmed using generative AI while declining to say whether it will expand the practice.

items.title: 谷歌给 Gemini 装"删除键"：AI 记住的隐私，现在你能看能改能删

sources.title_original: 谷歌给 Gemini 装"删除键"：AI 记住的隐私，现在你能看能改能删
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 想弄清 Gemini 到底记住了你什么，这篇梳理了 Google 11月9日推出的 Memory summary：用户可在 Settings 的 Personal Intelligence 下查看、编辑或删除个人背景、关系、工作、兴趣与偏好，并回看更改历史。

en.title: Google gives Gemini a 'delete button': you can now see, edit and delete what the AI remembers
en.reason: Google's November 9 Memory summary lets Gemini users see, edit or delete stored personal background, relationships, work, interests and preferences under Settings' Personal Intelligence, and review their change history.
